Please solve this issue: You are fixing a Minecraft-parity bug in the Pumpkin server (Rust, target MC 26.2). Work only inside this repo.

Bug A2: skyDarken is never tracked
Files: `pumpkin/src/world/mod.rs`, `get_max_local_raw_brightness`
What is wrong: It always passes `ambient_darkness = 0`, with a TODO saying the sky darken value is not tracked. Grass spreads at night as if it were noon, and night mob spawning thresholds are wrong.
Verified vanilla behaviour: Sky light is reduced by an ambient darkness derived from time of day.
The change to make: Track the value on the world, update it with the day cycle, and pass it.
Be careful: The subtraction is on a `u8`. An underflow here wraps to ~250 and then a later clamp yields 15, i.e. a silent false-bright. Saturating-subtract.

Make the smallest change that fixes exactly this. Do not touch unrelated code. When done, run `cargo build -p pumpkin` and make sure it compiles, then stop. Do not commit.
